# Overtime Policy

## 1. Eligibility

Overtime is payable only to employees whose job grade is marked as overtime
eligible. Employees in grades that are not overtime eligible may instead take
time off in lieu, arranged with their line manager.

## 2. Rates

Weekday overtime is paid at 1.25 times the basic hourly rate. Work performed on
a weekend or a public holiday is paid at 1.5 times the basic hourly rate.

## 3. Limits

No employee may work more than 12 hours of overtime in a single week without
written approval from the department head.

## 4. Recording

Overtime must be recorded through the attendance system in the same month it was
worked. Claims submitted after the payroll cut-off are carried to the following
month.
